name: aimarket-symmartys
summary: SYMMARTYS — public-record facts for agents that trade: EU VAT validity (VIES), legal entities (GLEIF LEI), national company registers, EORI, domain registrations (RDAP), ECB reference rates, sanctions-list lookups (OFAC, EU, UN), business-day calendars, Bitcoin-anchored timestamps (OpenTimestamps), web pages captured as evidence and timers with a dead man's switch, each answer signed with its sources
